subject: Operations
title: KFC Runs Out of Chicken
description: A quick win: understand KFC Runs Out of Chicken.

hook.text: In 2018, KFC closed 900 UK stores because it ran out of chicken. A chicken restaurant with no chicken.

buildup.text: KFC had just switched its UK logistics from Bidvest to DHL, a company with no experience in fresh food distribution.

discovery.text: DHL's single distribution center couldn't handle the volume. Deliveries failed within days of the switchover.

twist.text: KFC's cost-saving decision to consolidate from six warehouses to one created a single point of failure.

climax.text: KFC's cheeky apology ad rearranging its letters to FCK won public sympathy—but the logistics lesson was clear.

punchline.text: Saving on logistics cost KFC millions in lost chicken sales.

quiz.question: Why did KFC UK run out of chicken?
options: A logistics switch to one warehouse failed
